acceptable_paraphrases: A shape that has 12 edges, 7 vertices, and 7 faces
critical_errors: incorrect combination of edges, vertices, and faces
misconceptions: believing the shape can have more than one type of face (only triangles allowed for polyhedra with these numbers)
thinking it could be a regular solid if not all faces are identical
assuming the number of edges, vertices, and faces must match standard Platonic or Archimedean solids
grading_notes: Award full points if the answer matches any correct combination. Partial credit for identifying one correct attribute (e.g., 12 edges) but not others.
